notes.title: Update Notes v1.03 — Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
[p]This update focuses on fixing several issues and polishing the gameplay experience.
Below are the changes included in this patch:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed level 3-10 and removed a ghost rock that was not intended to be there.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved level 4-10 design to better show the correct laser path.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the level solution in level 6-10 that did not properly complete with 3 paws.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level 8-8 to correctly display the end-of-level message.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level 8-10 where, in some cases, the end of the game was not displayed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Steam achievements “Complete World 3” and “Complete World 8” not unlocking properly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and for your feedback — it helps us make the game better for everyone![/p]

notes.title: Update notes for May 14
